_readme: Expected SHA-256 digests of the docling model weights baked into Dockerfile.worker
`docling-tools` has no --revision or any other version argument, so the weights it
pulls from HuggingFace are whatever those repositories hold on build day, even though
the Python client itself is hash-locked. This file is how that gap is closed:
eval/docling/verify-model-artifacts.mjs runs in the same RUN layer as the download
and fails the build when what arrived is not what is recorded here.
treeDigest is null because no build has recorded one yet. In that state the verifier
prints the digest the download produced and exits 0 rather than failing, because the
digest can only be learned by running the download — refusing to build until one is
recorded would make the very build that produces it impossible.
TO PIN IT (one operator action, needs Docker and HuggingFace egress):
2. In the build log, find the block after `[docling-models] Record it by replacing`.
3. Replace this file's contents with that block and commit it.
From that commit on, any change to the upstream weights fails the image build.
